concerts.title: Concerts
concerts.noArtistBody: Concerts are created per represented artist. Liverty Music adds represented artists on request. Contact your representative.
concerts.artistNotFound: The concerts of this artist cannot be opened: it is not a represented artist.

verification.note: Entries already made are not checked again.

sale.verificationFailed: Could not change the verification requirement

prerequisite.notPublished: Publish the date to start selling
prerequisite.notPublishedBody: A sale cannot start for an unpublished date.
prerequisite.noStartTimeBody: A sale needs the date’s start time.
prerequisite.businessDetailsBody: Liverty Music enters your business details (the commercial transactions disclosure) during vetting. Contact your Liverty Music representative to add or change them. Sales cannot start until they are complete.
prerequisite.noStockBody: To start a sale, first add the seat types and quantities this date sells in “Seat types and quantities” below.

referral.title: Purchases per referral code
referral.note: Only paid purchases are counted. Refunded purchases are not counted. A lottery entry is counted once it won and was charged.

sale.title: Sales
sale.sharedStocks: Every sale sells the seat types in “Seat types and quantities” above, from the same quantities. One account may hold up to {{limit, number}} tickets for this date across all sales.

concert.publishConfirmPublic: The chosen dates are published together and the performers’ followers are notified once. A published date cannot return to draft.
concert.publishConfirmUnlisted: The chosen dates are published together. No follower is notified. A published date cannot return to draft.
concert.cancelConfirmBody: Every published date is cancelled and fans are told once. Draft dates are removed. This cannot be undone.

event.publishSlotUsed: Could not publish: another concert already has a date at this venue, date and start time, or a cancelled date is there. Change the date or start time in the concert editor.
event.publishConfirmPublic: This publishes this date alone and notifies the performers’ followers. To announce several dates with one notification, publish them from the concert page. A published date cannot return to draft.
event.publishConfirmUnlisted: This publishes this date alone. No follower is notified. A published date cannot return to draft.
event.cancelConfirmPublished: The date will be cancelled and fans will be told. This cannot be undone.
event.cancelConfirmDraft: The draft date will be removed. This cannot be undone.

reception.oneDevice: Each link works only on the first device that opens it.
reception.issueFailed: Could not issue a reception link
reception.loadFailed: Could not load the reception links.

prerequisite.notPublished: Publish the date to issue reception links

prerequisite.noStartTimeBody: Reception links need the date’s start time.

settings.title: Settings
settings.changeOnRequest: Liverty Music changes the name and the represented artists on request. Contact your representative.

business.title: Business details
business.explain: Liverty Music entered these during vetting. Fans see them on ticket sales as the commercial transactions disclosure. Contact your Liverty Music representative to change them.
business.incompleteBody: Sales cannot start until every business detail is registered.

payout.startFailed: Stripe’s page could not be opened. Please try again.
payout.stripe: Payouts go through Stripe, the payment provider of Liverty Music. On Stripe’s page you enter your business, your representative’s identity and the bank account to be paid into.

denied.title: This account cannot use the console
denied.body: You are signed in, but this account has no access to the organizer console. Sign in with another account or contact your Liverty Music representative.

concertEditor.correctionNote: This concert has published or cancelled dates, so its type and visibility are fixed, and a published date keeps its venue and date. New dates stay drafts until you publish them.

concertEditor.publishedNote: Published: the venue and date are fixed. To move it, cancel this date and add a new one.
concertEditor.saveRejected: This change could not be saved: a published date’s venue and date, the type and the visibility are fixed.

stock.addRefused: A cancelled date cannot get seat types.
